name: Mahmoud Abbas
role: President of the Palestinian Authority (2005–) and chairman of the PLO (2004–)
summary: Abbas leads Fatah, the PLO and the Palestinian Authority. His stated positions are a negotiated two-state settlement on the 1967 lines with East Jerusalem as capital, a refugee solution under resolution 194, non-violence and rejection of terrorism, and recourse to the UN and international courts.
